privacyText: KabanGo has no advertising trackers or analytics. Favorites, want-to-try lists, recent searches, review drafts, community drafts, and chats are stored in this browser using IndexedDB. Clearing site data removes them. Location is requested only when you choose Near me or Your location. It is used locally for distances; OSRM receives route coordinates when you request an online route. OpenStreetMap receives tile requests and your IP address. Google Maps links open Google and are covered by its privacy policy. Optional cloud AI receives your message, a random session ID and selected restaurant IDs, never your exact GPS. Its provider may process requests under its own terms. Private on-device AI downloads model files from third parties, then runs messages locally. Free cloud services have quotas. Reviews and listing changes are local drafts, not public submissions. This release uses fictional restaurant and fare samples. No accounts or payments are required.
